journey.title: Choose 'No symptoms' after ticking symptoms with the keyboard
journey.goal: Ticking the exclusive 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' answer clears the symptoms ticked earlier

functionalJourney.title: Tick two symptoms with a pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Both ticked symptoms are submitted and no-symptoms stays clear

guards.title: Choose 'Do not contact me' after ticking a contact method
guards.goal: The exclusive answer in a shared-name group clears the method ticked earlier

plan.root_cause: The module import attempts to import a named export `initCheckboxes` which does not exist; the module likely provides a default export, leaving `initCheckboxes` undefined and preventing the checkboxes enhancement (including exclusive behavior) from running.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the import statement to import the default export from the checkboxes module and then invoke it, ensuring the enhancement runs and exclusive checkboxes clear other options in their group.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Selecting the exclusive 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' checkbox will now clear any previously selected symptom checkboxes, providing correct keyboard-operated exclusive choice behavior and satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (keyboard) and 4.1.2 (name, role, value).
functional_risks: If the module does not actually provide a default export, the import will fail and the checkboxes enhancement will not run, potentially breaking other checkbox functionality.
If the module relies on the named export for other internal usage, changing the import could cause unexpected behavior.
verification_requirements: After applying the edit, executing the journey steps (tick cough, tick fever, then tick 'no symptoms') should result in symptoms[cough] and symptoms[fever] being cleared (value []).
The regression guard for choosing 'Do not contact me' after ticking a contact method should continue to pass.
All existing functional checks and success criteria should remain satisfied.

plan.root_cause: The checkboxes module fails to load because the ES module import does not match the module's exports (neither named nor default), preventing the exclusive checkbox behavior from initializing.
plan.repair_strategy: Replace the failing module import with an inline script that implements exclusive checkbox behavior directly, ensuring keyboard-operable exclusive choice for both symptoms and contact groups.

edits.after:
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  // Exclusive checkbox behavior for data-checkbox-exclusive and data-checkbox-exclusive-group
  document.querySelectorAll('input[data-checkbox-exclusive]').forEach(function(exclusiveCheckbox) {
    exclusiveCheckbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
      if (this.checked) {
        var group = this.getAttribute('data-checkbox-exclusive-group');
        if (group) {
          document.querySelectorAll('input[data-checkbox-exclusive-group="' + group + '"]:not([data-checkbox-exclusive])').forEach(function(cb) {
            cb.checked = false;
            cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
          });
        }
      }
    });
  });
  // Uncheck exclusive when a non-exclusive in same group is checked
  document.querySelectorAll('input[data-checkbox-exclusive-group]:not([data-checkbox-exclusive])').forEach(function(cb) {
    cb.addEventListener('change', function() {
      if (this.checked) {
        var group = this.getAttribute('data-checkbox-exclusive-group');
        document.querySelectorAll('input[data-checkbox-exclusive][data-checkbox-exclusive-group="' + group + '"]').forEach(function(excl) {
          excl.checked = false;
          excl.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        });
      }
    });
  });
});
</script>

plan.root_cause: The ES module import for the checkboxes component fails because the module does not export 'initCheckboxes' (neither named nor default), leaving exclusive checkbox behavior uninitialized for both symptoms and contact groups. The contact group lacks data-checkbox-exclusive-group attributes, relying only on shared name='contact', which the previous inline script did not handle.
plan.repair_strategy: Replace the failing module import with an inline script that implements exclusive checkbox behavior using data-checkbox-exclusive-group when present, falling back to the shared name attribute for grouping. This ensures both symptoms and contact exclusive checkboxes clear their respective groups on keyboard or pointer interaction.

edits.after:
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  function getGroup(cb) {
    return cb.getAttribute('data-checkbox-exclusive-group') || cb.name;
  }
  function getNonExclusiveInGroup(group) {
    var byAttr = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[data-checkbox-exclusive-group="' + group + '"]:not([data-checkbox-exclusive])'));
    if (byAttr.length) return byAttr;
    return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[name="' + group + '"]:not([data-checkbox-exclusive])'));
  }
  function getExclusiveInGroup(group) {
    return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[data-checkbox-exclusive]')).filter(function(excl) {
      return getGroup(excl) === group;
    });
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('input[data-checkbox-exclusive]').forEach(function(exclusiveCheckbox) {
    exclusiveCheckbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
      if (this.checked) {
        var group = getGroup(this);
        var nonExclusive = getNonExclusiveInGroup(group);
        nonExclusive.forEach(function(cb) {
          cb.checked = false;
          cb.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        });
      }
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]:not([data-checkbox-exclusive])').forEach(function(cb) {
    cb.addEventListener('change', function() {
      if (this.checked) {
        var group = getGroup(this);
        var exclusives = getExclusiveInGroup(group);
        exclusives.forEach(function(excl) {
          excl.checked = false;
          excl.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        });
      }
    });
  });
});
</script>

plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Selecting the exclusive 'No, I do not have any of these symptoms' checkbox clears previously selected symptom checkboxes, and selecting 'Do not contact me' clears other contact methods, providing correct keyboard-operated exclusive choice behavior for both groups and satisfying WCAG 2.1.1 (keyboard) and 4.1.2 (name, role, value).
functional_risks: Inline script may not cover all edge cases of the original module (e.g., dynamic groups, nested forms).
If the original module provides additional enhancements (e.g., ARIA attributes), they will be missing.
verification_requirements: After applying the edit, executing the journey steps (tick cough, tick fever, then tick 'no symptoms') should result in symptoms[cough] and symptoms[fever] being cleared (value []).
The regression guard for choosing 'Do not contact me' after ticking a contact method should pass (contact value ['none']).
All existing functional checks and success criteria should remain satisfied.
